pageCache.text:
A Warm Welcome to
Coney Hill Community Primary School!
Welcome to our school website; I am the very proud Headteacher of Coney Hill Community Primary School. We pride ourselves on providing an excellent education in a secure, nurturing and inclusive environment.
Our curriculum is rich and exciting - underpinned by our PREACH values. Every child at our school accesses a broad and balanced, active and engaging curriculum, through quality teaching and learning experiences, which not only leads to excellent outcomes for our pupils, but also prepares them well for the future.
Our pupils benefit from our outstanding pastoral support, which provides focused attention in meeting the children’s individual needs and support for our families. We pride ourselves on our inclusivity and our strong relationships with all families, from all backgrounds.
We are very much a team at Coney Hill - The Hillers - and are dedicated to working with all of our children, parents, Governors and wider community to ensure that our learners get the very best, as they deserve it.
Exploring the information on our website will provide a flavour of what life is like at Coney Hill Community Primary school, but we would encourage you to visit us, meet our staff and pupils, and discover for yourself how your child could thrive here. Thank you for visiting our website and taking an interest in our school.
Class Dojo and School Calendar
Please download the Class Dojo app! Our teachers regularly post updates about your child's learning on Dojo and we also share important reminders on here.
In addition, our school calendar on Class Dojo details our upcoming events, activities and important dates!
If you have any queries please contact the school office on 01452 522734 oremail; admin@coneyhill.gloucs.sch.uk
Ofsted inspection report
We are absolutely thrilled to share our recent Ofsted inspection report and that it was recognised that we have been graded as a GOOD school with OUTSTANDING features! So much of what we pride ourselves on has been acknowledged by the inspectors and included in the report. #ProudToBeAHiller
Here are some comments from the report;
"Coney Hill is an inclusive school which cares deeply for its pupils. It provides a calm and nurturing environment. The school motto, ‘#ProudtobeaHiller’ shines through in pupils and adults alike. Pupils enjoy school and attend regularly."
"Pupils behave exceptionally well during lessons and social times. They demonstrate high levels of respect and kindness towards one another."
"The provision for pupils’ wider personal development is impressive. They value the rich and varied opportunities available. These help to develop their skills and interests in many areas such as music and sports."
Click here to view our recent Ofsted report
Just some of the recent feedback from our Parent survey. Making us #ProudToBeAHiller every day.
"Thank you Coney Hill for all you do, couldn’t ask for more. Total and utter dedication from staff and an infectiously positive atmosphere."
"Celebrating and championing all children. Incredible progress/achievements in all areas of learning and development."
"The feeling that it’s a family."
"Staff are always there to listen and advise, it’s a friendly open and transparent school, always there for the needs of my children."

pageCache.pageTitle: Coney Hill Community Primary School - Our School, vision and values
pageCache.text:
Our School
Coney Hill Community Primary School is a city school, serving the community of Coney Hill and close surrounding area. We are a one form entry school, with an integrated "Happy Hillers" preschool.
Our School Vision
At Coney Hill Community Primary School, our vision is to offer the best possible education in partnership with parents and the local community. We embody pride, respect and support for all, while nurturing the potential of every child, regardless of background or starting point and equipping them with the knowledge and skills to thrive in modern Britain.
Our school mottos are: Proud to be a Hiller and Be the best you can be
Our core "PREACH" values are central to all we are and what we do here.
Our "PREACH" values
At Coney Hill Community Primary School, we believe that high quality, engagaing teaching leads to effective learning and this is what we strive for in every lesson. We have high aspirations for our children and our staff. As a result, children are provided with high quality learning experiences, resulting in a high level of pupil achievement across all areas of the curriculum.
Purpose and Pride
Respect
Enjoyment
Achieve and Aspire
Community
Health and Wellbeing
#ProudtobeaHiller
We pride ourselves on a positive approach to behaviour, through a carefully structured system of rewards, using a restorative approach to managing misbehaviour. Rewards, such as Pride Points, are given not only for academic effort or achievement, but also for contributions towards the school ethos - displaying our PREACH values through everyday school life.
What our children have to say about their school is hugely important to us. Through the School Council, Play Leaders, House Captains and Vice-Captains, we provide the opportunity for pupils to have some influence, leadership and say, in areas of school life.
Our Hiller staff team is hard-working, committed and dedicated to the education and wellbeing of our children; each member of our teaching staff is fundamental to ensuring that our children have enriched lives and experiences. This is achieved through our wide range of extra-curricular activites such as choir, art club, mindfulness club, various sports clubs and outdoor learning club.
Our passion lies in enabling all of our children to overcome any barriers they might have to learning; we want our children to enjoy and achieve no matter what their starting point. Our Hub team and SENDCO are instrumental in ensuring that every child can access their learning and reach their full potential.

Ofsted Parent View
Ofsted Parent View gives you the chance to tell Ofsted what you think of our school, including:
- how happy your child is at school
- how school manages bullying or challenging behaviour
If your child has special educational needs and/or disabilities (SEND), they will ask how well our school supports them.
The questionnaire can be completed at any time - you don’t have to wait until our school is being inspected. Ofsted will use your responses to help them plan inspections.
The information you provide can:
- inform discussions inspectors have with our school leaders during an inspection
- help Ofsted decide when to inspect a school
In addition to this, Ofsted also publish the overall summary of the responses to Ofsted Parent View. This information is anonymised.
Click on the link below to access the Ofsted Parent View website, then click on ‘Give your views now’ to register and complete a survey to help our school improve.
